name: Bones & Bounty
review:
Bones & Bounty is a haunted 6-reel pirate slot with 4,096 ways. Wilds and stacked respin wilds drive the base game, and the Cash Bonus Game adds persistent payers and multiplier cash symbols.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 25,000x cap and a 96.16% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
